articles.headline: Soccer's main characters: Man United, Como, PSG, Donnarumma
articles.description: What are we watching this week? Man United are hoping for a rally, Como are magical to watch, PSG are the team to beat and we're worried about Gianluigi Donnarumma.

articles.headline: Portugal, Man United, Real Madrid: Cristiano Ronaldo's long history of rows with coaches
